title: Trust Tech Alliance - Company Overview
content: Trust Tech Alliance operates across software development, artificial intelligence and automation, cloud and infrastructure services, cybersecurity, IT operations, HR and PMO solutions, leadership services, digital marketing, and research and development. Its public portfolio includes work related to telecommunications, banking and finance, public-sector organizations, healthcare, cloud infrastructure, networking, and cybersecurity.

title: Zenoa - Company and Technology Overview
content: Zenoa provides technology products and services with a strong focus on automotive businesses. Its public information covers automotive parts businesses, software development, artificial intelligence, automation, cybersecurity, research and development, CRM capabilities, sales automation, support automation, and enterprise technology integrations.

title: Trust Tech Alliance - Products and Services
content: Trust Tech Alliance provides software development, cloud and infrastructure services, cybersecurity and compliance, AI and automation solutions, operations as a service, leadership as a service, smart managed office services, virtual co-working services, digital marketing, and research and development services. AI and automation services focus on improving business processes, reducing repetitive work, supporting operational efficiency, and applying artificial intelligence to business workflows.

title: Zenoa - Products and Services
content: Zenoa provides technology solutions for automotive businesses, including inventory management, spare-parts platforms, AI-based parts lookup, software development, automation, cybersecurity, R&D, CRM-related capabilities, sales automation, support automation, and enterprise system integrations. Its products and integrations support inventory, sales, customer management, financial processes, and business analytics.

title: Accounting and Enterprise System Integrations
content: Public information from Zenoa demonstrates integrations with enterprise systems including Xero, Pinnacle, SYSTIME, Orion, and Inknowtech. Xero integration supports accounting and financial processes such as invoicing, reconciliation, and financial reporting. DMS-related integrations support synchronization of business information such as inventory, orders, and supplier-related data. Public information also describes API-based connectivity between enterprise systems and business analytics involving revenue, inventory trends, warehouse operations, sales performance, customer insights, forecasting, and key performance indicators. Private API credentials, authentication tokens, passwords, and internal API endpoints are not publicly available and require authorized organizational access.
